wire_candidate.encoding: Candidate domains above denote exactly one final LF byte (0A), not backslash+n bytes. Body is strict UTF-8 JSON object, precisely listed field order, no whitespace, duplicate/extra/missing keys, nulls, floats or exponent numbers. Identifiers restricted to ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._:-], 1..128 bytes; UUIDv4 and lowerhex64 have their exact narrower grammars. JSON strings use ordinary double quotes with no escapes because allowed characters exclude quotes/backslashes/control bytes. Integers decimal digits without leading zero, 1..9007199254740991. No raw Profile/Session/URL/bearer/key/token bytes. Candidate body bound 8192 bytes, envelope bound 12288 bytes; parser rejects before journal mutation. Bounds are proposed parser caps, not selected lifetime policy. Literal purpose/audience values follow their exact literals, not the opaque-identifier grammar. client_type requires an exact Core/Apple accepted allowlist before implementation; unrecognised values close. No permission is inferred from a client_type string.
wire_candidate.signature: Candidate registered P-256 public JWK exact canonical pin, ECDSA/SHA256 fixed64-byte P1363 signature over domain LF plus canonical body bytes, without application prehash. Envelope exactly {body_b64url,signature_b64url}; unpadded canonical base64url. No key generation or real signer selected.
wire_candidate.route_state: A/B receipt DTOs are specified for passive source preparation only. Management/native effect routes are not part of this normative passive increment and remain unavailable.

digest_preimages.canonicalization: Use the same fixed-order closed canonical JSON primitive rules as receipt bodies. Private identifier values stay Core-local; hashes are signed bindings, not proof of independent API discovery of private state.

lifecycle.restart: Load real ordinary HA tuple and separate purpose record independently. Require exact current match + accepted restore/clock/store/principal evidence. Mismatch/unknown closes; never repair one from the other.
lifecycle.legacy: Existing pairs have no invented historical epoch: require genuine fresh current pairing validation and new push-purpose ACK. Legacy rows retain only old scope/expiry; no automatic migration or fake Session.
lifecycle.unknown: Lost native/key/provider/commit reply remains UNKNOWN; original operation spent, no new UUID/retry/lease. Poll returns state only. Recovery policy must be reviewed separately.
lifecycle.response_candidate: Nonsecret closed states WAITING_AUTHORITY, UNAVAILABLE, RESERVED, VERIFIED_DEVICE_TRANSPORT, BOUND_STATUS_CHILD, EXPIRED, RETIRED, REJECTED, UNKNOWN. VERIFIED/BOUND require actual full prerequisites and definitive relevant commit; no response can equate provider acceptance with delivery/render/currentness.

profile: read back effective settings and SQLite build
sqlite_contract.authority: One transaction domain for principal replay, operations, nonce spends, jobs, A/B/target generations, global actual-key counters and attempt outcomes; no authoritative dual write in D1 or HA.
sqlite_contract.atomicity: Explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE; validate original expected revisions and all scope joins; immutable operation/nonce global uniqueness; apply joint CAS and counter transition; invariant failure rolls back transaction. Report committed only after COMMIT returns definitive success under actual provider contract.
sqlite_contract.counter: Key reference globally unique across jobs/principal/pairing epochs; immutable key scope and strictly monotonic accepted counter with uint32 exhaustion closing. Restart, renewal or token rotation never resets.
sqlite_contract.capability: Consume private in-process reservation once before validation/await. No serialized/reconstituted positive capability or reply cache.
outcomes: DEFINITIVELY_NOT_COMMITTED only where actual adapter proves transaction did not commit
COMMITTED only after definitive provider settlement
UNKNOWN on lost/ambiguous commit acknowledgement; never assume rollback or reissue
COMMITTED_BUT_SUPPRESSED when cancel/expiry/retirement observed after actual commit; preserve SQL truth
sqlite_contract.cancellation: A cancelled await does not stop a worker thread or prove rollback. Connection work settles under adapter ownership; before settlement return no positive result. Preserve spent operation and uncertainty fence.
sqlite_contract.restore: Record actual store/boot/restore generation. Unknown restore or rollback fences positive use; equal HA and push records alone do not prove nonrollback. Host/VFS/powerloss/restore qualification remains required.
